name: Himalayas Remote Jobs
author: himalayasapp

sections.description:
Himalayas is a remote jobs marketplace. This official plugin shows its live jobs on your WordPress site. Lists and careers pages need no account and no setup.

Two blocks and a shortcode

  • Remote Jobs. Jobs for a role, skill or country. “Nursing jobs open to people in Australia”, “React jobs open worldwide”, “entry-level customer support jobs”. Pick the filters in the block sidebar and the preview updates as you go.
  • Company Careers. One company’s open roles, straight from its Himalayas profile. Post a job on Himalayas and it appears on your careers page; close it and it disappears. Nothing to copy across.
  • A searchable jobs page. Turn on “Let visitors search” and the Remote Jobs block gets a search box, a country picker and pages of 20 jobs, so it can be your site’s jobs page. Search needs your site’s free Himalayas API key.
  • Shortcode for the classic editor and page builders: [himalayas_jobs country="AU" search="nurse"].

Made to fit in

  • Rendered on your server as plain HTML, so jobs show without JavaScript and search engines can read them.
  • Uses your theme’s fonts and colours. Every shade is derived from your text colour, so it works on light and dark themes. Block colour, spacing and font size controls work as usual.
  • List or card layout, 1 to 20 jobs, logos, salary, short description and posting date, each optional.
  • Fast: jobs are saved on your server and refreshed in the background before they go stale (hourly by default, you can change this), so most page views never wait on Himalayas. If Himalayas cannot be reached, the last saved jobs keep showing.
  • Search result pages are marked noindex, so search engines index your jobs page but not every search a visitor runs.
  • Translated into Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese, and works right to left.
  • Works with any theme. Accessible markup: real lists, real headings, visible focus, and the whole row is clickable.

Each job shows

Title, company, where it can be done from (“Remote worldwide” or “Remote in Australia”), salary when the employer lists one, job type and when it was posted. Each job links to its page on Himalayas, where people read the full description and apply.

External services

This plugin shows data from Himalayas (https://himalayas.app), a remote jobs marketplace run by Himalayas. It cannot work without it.

  • What is sent, and when: when a page with a Remote Jobs or Company Careers block or the [himalayas_jobs] shortcode is viewed or previewed in the editor and no saved copy is fresh, and in a background refresh every 15 minutes for lists that are about to go stale, your server requests https://himalayas.app/jobs/api/search with the list’s filters (keyword, country, seniority, job type, company, order, page). The request includes your site’s address in the User-Agent header and, if you added one, your API key.
  • Visitor search: when visitor search is on, the keyword and country a visitor types are sent the same way, from your server. Nothing that identifies the visitor is sent: no IP address, cookie or account.
  • Company logos are loaded by visitors’ browsers from cdn-images.himalayas.app.
  • Links go to job and company pages on himalayas.app and include utm_ parameters naming your site, so Himalayas can tell visits from this plugin apart from other traffic. When a visitor clicks one, their browser sends Himalayas the address of the page they came from, as with any link.
  • Terms of use, including the API terms: https://himalayas.app/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://himalayas.app/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. In the block editor, add the Remote Jobs or Company Careers block. Or add the [himalayas_jobs] shortcode anywhere shortcodes work.
  3. To let visitors search, get a free API key at https://himalayas.app/signup/developer, add it under Settings → Himalayas Jobs, and turn on “Let visitors search” in the block sidebar (or add searchable="true" to the shortcode).
  4. Optional: in the same settings, change how often jobs refresh, or choose whether jobs open in a new tab.
sections.faq:
Does it cost anything?

No. The plugin and the Himalayas jobs API are free. An API key is free too. Lists and careers pages work without one; visitor search needs one, and it gives your site its own, higher rate limit.

Can visitors search for jobs on my site?

Yes. Add your free API key, then turn on “Let visitors search” on a Remote Jobs block. Visitors get a keyword box, a country picker and pages of 20 jobs. The block’s own filters are what they see before searching. Each job still opens on Himalayas, where people read the full description and apply.

Searches use the URL parameters jobs_q, jobs_country and jobs_page, so results can be bookmarked and shared. Those result pages are noindex.

What shortcode options are there?

  • search: a role or keyword, like search="product designer"
  • country: a two-letter country code, like country="AU". Shows jobs open to people in that country, including jobs open worldwide.
  • country_only="true": with country, leaves out jobs open worldwide
  • worldwide="true": only jobs open worldwide
  • seniority: Entry-level, Mid-level, Senior, Manager, Director or Executive
  • type: Full Time, Part Time, Contractor, Temporary, Intern or Volunteer
  • company: a company’s Himalayas link or slug, like company="your-company"
  • sort: recent (default), relevant or salaryDesc
  • limit: 1 to 20 (default 6, or 20 for a company)
  • layout: list or cards, and columns from 1 to 4 for cards
  • show_logo, show_salary, show_excerpt, show_date, show_view_all: true or false
  • heading and heading_level (2 to 5)
  • searchable="true": adds visitor search (needs an API key)

How do I show my own company’s jobs?

Post your jobs on Himalayas (https://himalayas.app/post), then add the Company Careers block and paste your company profile link. Your open roles stay in sync on their own.

Can I style it?

Yes. Everything uses himalayas-jobs classes and a few CSS custom properties (--hj-radius, --hj-logo, --hj-line, --hj-accent) that your theme can override.

Is there a credit link?

Each job links to its page on Himalayas, and a “View all jobs” link points to the matching search there. You can hide that link per list. A small “Jobs from Himalayas” credit is off by default; turn it on in the settings if you like.

Do the jobs get JobPosting structured data?

No. Google only allows job structured data on the page of a single job, so lists like these should not carry it. Each job’s own page on Himalayas has it.

1.0.0

  • First release: Remote Jobs and Company Careers blocks, visitor search, [himalayas_jobs] shortcode, settings page, background refresh, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese translations.
